summary.intent: Execute, verify, gap-close, and ship GSD phase 68.1 (wiring the CipherBox web app onto the node/v3 read+write chain), then respond to live bugs found during post-ship local smoke testing.
summary.outcome: Phase 68.1 reached verification PASSED (5/5) after multiple gap-closure rounds, shipped as PR #588 (all CI green, mergeable, merge left to user), and post-ship smoke testing surfaced two more real bugs (stale owner view of shared-out folders, missing file size/modified-date) which were being actively diagnosed/fixed (a SealedChildRef metadata-mirror feature) at transcript end.

repo: Write plane is keyed by node UUID (WriteChildRef.childId / childPub.id), read plane by ipnsName (SealedChildRef) — conflating the two causes write-capability bugs (root cause of the move/nested-share/cold-load write bugs found this phase).
D-03: getWriteBodyParams fail-opens to {} on a zero/absent writeKey rather than throwing — duplicated in client.ts and bin/index.ts, both need fixing together if flipped.
D-09: only the terminal owner of a key buffer zeroes it; callees must never zero caller-owned buffers.
CI's unit-test job does NOT run apps/web tests at all (web is covered only by Playwright web-e2e) — a broken web unit test/mock can rot silently without going CI-red.
CodeRabbit CLI has a 150-file diff cap; large phase diffs must be run directory-scoped (apps/packages/tests) instead of one pass.
mock-ipns-routing (delegated routing mock) keeps records in an in-memory Map — wiped on every container restart; records need a DB row (ipns_records) to survive.
1Password SSH commit signing frequently times out (exit 143) without the commit actually failing — always verify via `git log -1` before retrying, never blind-retry.
vite must be restarted with --force (dep re-optimize) after rebuilding sdk/sdk-core dist, otherwise the running web app keeps serving stale pre-rebuild client code.

EmailOtpService only logs the plaintext dev OTP to console when NODE_ENV is 'development' or unset; running the API under an E2E-style .env (NODE_ENV=test/production) silently swallows OTPs since SendGrid isn't configured either.
SealedChildRef is a frozen/versioned schema (NODE-03 golden vectors) — new fields must be optional and conditionally serialized so old records stay byte-identical.
resyncFolder exists but has zero call sites — dead code, not an active refresh path.

Subfolder navigation uses a cached fast-path (isLoaded) and never re-resolves IPNS on entry; only root gets a 30s poll, so shared-out folder contents written by another party go unseen until the owner writes or reloads.
git stash must never be used in this repo (shared refs/stash across worktrees) — two executor agents violated this rule mid-session and had to self-recover.

code.finding: moveItem re-homes the moved child's WriteChildRef from source to dest write-body, keyed by resolved node UUID (childPub.id), not the ipnsName-based moveItem childId param.
buildSharedWriteContextFromState omits ipnsPrivateKey; shared writes recover the real IPNS signing key from the unsealed write-body via writeKey, not the seeded all-zero key.
navigateUp only re-derives writeKey when isRootDepth is true; restoring a deeper nested-share subfolder loses write capability (deferred known gap).
publishWithCas's decodeRemote never unsealed the remote write-body on 409, so mergeChildren only merged the read-body — concurrent writers' WriteChildRefs were silently dropped (real bug, fixed).
sizeDisplay/dateDisplay hardcoded as phase-63 stubs ('-' and formatDate(0)) because SealedChildRef never carried size/mtime; fixed by adding optional mirror fields to the schema.
SDK-event handler hybrid-projects: sync insert only when every child's kind is already cached, else awaits resolveKinds with a stale-sequence guard — fixes the D-02 async kind-cache race.

workflow: Background agents that launch long-running shell commands (full e2e suites) frequently 'lose their wake' — transcript gets evicted and the agent never resumes on completion; mitigated with disk-state spot-checks, prompt-based SendMessage resume, or a fresh continuation agent with explicit completed_state.

Playwright specs here use describe.serial per file — a single early failure cascades and skips the rest of that file, so raw 'N failed' tallies understate real coverage; must check first-failure position per file, not just aggregate counts.

Session/usage limits killed multiple subagents mid-task across the shipping session; recovery required verifying exact disk state (git diff, uncommitted work) before resuming rather than assuming a clean restart.
For a large ship-phase diff, splitting review passes by directory and running SDK E2E + unit coverage locally before pushing avoids CI round-trips.

friction: Repeated session/usage-limit deaths (Claude and Fable) killed subagents mid-execution multiple times, requiring manual disk-state recovery each time.

Background e2e-suite agents twice 'lost their wake' after the suite finished, requiring watchdogs and prompt-resume workarounds; one watchdog itself was based on a file (.last-run.json) this playwright config never writes.
CodeRabbit's 150-file cap was hit twice (locally and on the PR itself), forcing directory-scoped local reviews instead of a single PR-level pass.
1Password commit signing timeouts occurred repeatedly, requiring git log verification before any retry to avoid double-committing.
Two executor subagents violated the 'never git stash' rule mid-task and had to self-recover without data loss.
A stray `cd docker` left the cwd wrong, causing a false 'ROADMAP.md missing' scare.
vite serving stale pre-rebuild sdk dist required manual detection (comparing process start time to dist rebuild time) and a forced restart.
OTP extraction was blocked because the API was running under E2E .env (NODE_ENV suppressed) rather than development, requiring a diagnosis chain and API restart.
CI Test job failed post-ship on a stale shares.controller.spec.ts assertion unrelated to the ship session's direct edits, requiring investigation to confirm it wasn't a regression.
open_items: Recovery tool (recovery.html) still only accepts legacy v2 vault blobs vs v3 — needs its own port/feature plan (deferred, todo filed).
rotation-durability SC-4 relay-replay scenario is unreachable past the API's DB-canonical resolve floor — needs an apps/api architecture decision or test redesign (deferred, todo filed).
Restore-to-different-parent write-link re-homing shares the same bug class as the move fix but is an unshipped flow — documented as a follow-up, not fixed.
Nested write-share loses write capability on navigate-up/breadcrumb restore to an intermediate subfolder — documented known non-blocker in the shipped PR, todo filed.
Dead getShareKeys folder-ipns path (superseded, no live caller) flagged for removal.
Shared nav stack stores stale children by reference on breadcrumb restore — minor UX staleness, todo filed.
ipns.service.test.ts has a broken/incomplete mock causing a module-load crash; pre-existing, non-CI-gating (CI doesn't run apps/web unit tests), left unfixed with a todo.

getWriteBodyParams's D-03 fail-open can seal an empty write-body on a transient resolve miss (duplicated in client.ts and bin/index.ts) — flagged as a latent risk needing a holistic fix decision, not flipped unilaterally.
Delete currently retains a removed child's WriteChildRef indefinitely (chain growth) instead of dropping it — todo filed.
ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted naming inconsistency vs wire field encryptedIpnsPrivateKey — rename todo filed (blocked by forbidden-test-dir fixtures).
Owner sees a stale empty snapshot of a shared-out folder until they write into it or reload — newly found during smoke test, todo filed, workaround exists.

File size / modified-date not displayed in file list (hardcoded '-' / 1970 stub) — user chose the SealedChildRef metadata-mirror approach; core/sdk-core/sdk changes implemented and tested, UI wiring delegated to a subagent, dist rebuilt and vite restarted, but final commit/verification not yet confirmed complete at transcript end.

replaceFile/restoreFileVersion don't re-publish the parent folder, so the new size/mtime mirror will go stale after an in-place file edit until the folder is next written — accepted degradation, flagged as a follow-up rather than fixed inline.

Several simplify-pass todos remain open: dedupe SDK write-plane helpers, consolidate web shared-navigation duplication, hoist base64ToBytes into crypto package, remove legacy moveInSharedFolder share_keys branch, drop discarded per-upload ECIES wrapKey, and a download-progress UX decision for useFileDownload.
